periods.name: 赞达剌调查恰特情报
periods.summary: Kinji and Eliza investigate Chhat laborers, police-linked palladium trading and routes. Lucifelia and Monkey attract worship as animal-featured deities. Teacher Masi reveals young women are being taken and points to Titaro-Dado.
periods.outcome: Team gains safe route to Chhat and learns Carbuncle is abducting magic-bearing young women.
